title: Spatial Workbench, Descriptions & Voice · v0.10.0
changes: Reduced the single image-action popover to 90%, set it further behind the card plane; actions are EXTRACT, DESCRIBE, REFINE, PROMPT, VOICE and 3D.
Lowered the microphone/capture/extract trio; temporary statuses now appear as transparent readable text rather than large fixed cards.
Voice recording is now toggled by pressing the microphone again; a live 36-band volume/frequency ring displays levels, then transcript OK/Cancel without keyboard.
Descriptions of privately owned captures or extracted objects are requested explicitly from Meta, saved in SQLite, displayed in closable white cards and optionally spoken.
ElevenLabs added to server-side encrypted provider vault, with read-only voice catalog and explicitly opted-in synthetic mascot speech; system speech remains default.
3D Meshy status polling reports failure/progress, with successful models simplified into an untextured, bounded XR geometry preview. Full GLB remains downloadable.
LOG panel now moves independently in room space, can be resized or closed; non-admins no longer generate repeated Forbidden diagnostics calls.
Collapsing a cloud animates its stored cards toward the LIB icon; uploaded non-XR photographs can be saved to the same private spatial library.
Existing watcher unchanged; accounts, images, secrets, quotas, and experimental hand labs preserved.
